svg.text: The Bill's own path, not the applicant's
Is ar scáth a chéile a mhaireann na daoine
Sources: Oireachtas legislative process; General Scheme, Irish Nationality and Citizenship (Amendment) Bill 2026, published July 2026
months to a year or more
The General Scheme is not law.
It is a policy proposal. The Bill may change during scrutiny, and the numbers that
matter most — income threshold, welfare and housing lists, language and civics
standards, waiver categories — are set by regulation after enactment, not in the Act.
